verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for an AI app-building product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no open license or public repository for Figma Make's own source. The ability to view and edit generated app code (docs-7) concerns the user's app, not the product, and the community reverse-engineering of the .make format (comm-1) confirms that format is undocumented, not openly licensed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
